magnitude_input_rationale: scripts/26: the two ERA5-derived magnitude inputs rank the anchor event 176th and 193rd of 2,362 days (FAIL) because they inherit ERA5's underestimate of it; this one ranks it 12th (PASS) and is never fit to ERA5 sro.
verify_at_load: runoff_model recomputes index_at_anchor and refuses to anchor if it has moved by more than drift_tolerance. k is only valid for the formula and feature set that produced this index; a stale k yields confident wrong tonnages rather than an error.
one_point_caveat: ONE measurement fixes the SCALE, never the SHAPE. The formula has six terms and a single point constrains one degree of freedom, so any mass for a different event is an extrapolation along an unverified curve. Relative classes remain the honest output.
